name: Braixen
description: Braixen, the Fox Pokémon, and the evolved form of Fennekin. Able to evolve into Delphox. A Fire type.
pokedex_entries: It has a twig stuck in its tail. With friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.
When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.
